name: What's Yours Like
summary: Party guessing game where others describe their version of a hidden word and the hot-seat player tries to guess it in fewest clues.
rules_text: One player is in the Hot Seat. A Word Card is drawn and shown to all other players but hidden from the Hot Seat using a concealer. The Hot Seat asks each other player in clockwise order "What's yours like?" That player must give a truthful but clever description of their own instance of the Guess Word, not too literal and not too vague. The clue is recorded. After each clue the Hot Seat may guess the word, one guess per clue. Play continues around the table, each player giving a new clue on second circuits, until the word is guessed. The number of clues used is that player's score for the round. Then the next player becomes Hot Seat. After a predetermined number of rounds where everyone has been Hot Seat equally, lowest total score wins. Challenge Cards allow a Hot Seat player to duel another player on a new word with both guessing; winner subtracts two points.
rating_reason: Word guessing with hidden word and clue giving - text playable
